outcome: An operator can diagnose, stop and recover runs with attributable costs and durable evidence.
currentProblem: Internal provenance needs real runtime/provider mapping, retention and operational recovery procedures.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.
successCriteria: A fresh operator can explain blockers and inspect exact task/attempt/model/runtime/SCM identities without model-inferred provenance.
Cost and duration include failed/retried provider calls; missing usage is explicit and cannot appear as zero.
Backup/restore and process restart recover canonical runs; lost telemetry cannot grant or revoke product acceptance.
